row.notes: Log channel VEHICLE_DAMAGE: '%s: damage: %x, was broken: %d, is broken: %d' | '%s: reset damage' | '%s: left damage: %f, right damage: %f' | '%s: setFrontWingDamage: %f' | PR #453/#448 (vmknolle): VEHICLE_DAMAGE log '%s: damage: %x, was broken, is broken': if the wing was broken and the bits clear (& 0x3ff == 0) -> slot 0x18(0x1000) reset ('reset damage'); else left damage = max * (bits >> 5) / 30, right = max * (bits & 0x1f) / 30, total ratio clamped to [0,1] into [+0x90]+0x199c ('setFrontWingDamage').

verify.notes: V6733 strings name the function racing::collision::F1WingDamage::setNetBits; body is the wing damage net-bits setter. Better: Car_F1WingDamage_SetNetBits
